source.name: Opening a drawer must move keyboard focus into it
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43120) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Open the filters drawer and apply a filter with the keyboard
journey.goal: Opening the drawer moves focus into it, so the user can tick a filter and show results without a pointer

functionalJourney.title: Apply a filter with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking Filters, ticking Waterproof and clicking Show results applies the filter

guards.title: Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to Filters
guards.goal: After opening the drawer with the pointer, Escape closes it and focus is back on the Filters button

plan.root_cause: The drawer does not move focus to the first focusable element when opened, leaving focus on the page body and forcing keyboard users to navigate manually to reach controls.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a 'shown.bs.drawer' event listener in the Drawer constructor that focuses the first focusable element (respecting autofocus, then button, link, input, select, textarea, or tabindex>=0) after the drawer is shown.

edits.before:
constructor(element?: string | Element | null, config?: Partial<DrawerConfig> | null) {
    super(element, config)
    this._swipeHelper = null
    this._resizeObserver = null
    this._resizeFrame = null
    this._initResizeObserver()
  }

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When the drawer is opened via keyboard (Enter/Space on the toggle button), focus will move to the first focusable element inside the drawer (the close button), allowing immediate interaction with filter controls without extra navigation.
functional_risks: If an element inside the drawer has autofocus, it will receive focus instead of the close button (acceptable).
The focus selector may inadvertently match hidden or disabled elements; however the query excludes tabindex='-1' and relies on natural tab order.

Adding an event listener introduces minimal overhead; cleanup is not implemented but the listener is scoped to the drawer instance and removed when the drawer is disposed via the base class disposal (which removes all Bootstrap event listeners).
verification_requirements: Press Enter on #filters-open and assert focus moves to #filters-close.
Press Tab after opening and assert focus moves to #in-stock.
Press Space to toggle the checkbox, then Tab and assert focus moves to #apply.
Press Enter on #apply and assert #applied text updates to 'in'.
Press Escape on the drawer and assert focus returns to #filters-open and the drawer closes.
